notes:
BlocMod is now signed by AetherCarlyle Ltd, the company that publishes it: Windows names the publisher instead of an unknown one, and Smart App Control lets a signed app run. Windows may still warn about it for a while, until it has seen enough downloads of the signed builds. Thank you for testing.

- Add › Structure: Minecraft's own jigsaw structures, villages and more, put together in the scene as Minecraft builds them; As built shows its processors at work.
- Structures of your own that grow: side-by-side joins, fallbacks, processors on your own pieces, and a card that remembers its settings.
- Object Paint: copies of chosen objects placed with the mouse, with Scatter and a Scatter List of weighted objects.
- Tree, a tool for big trees of your own (Add › Tools), with Open, Forest and Cone crowns; example tools now come with BlocMod.
- Item frames and cushions, saved into every file format as Minecraft's own entities.
- The block search finds kinds of block, by Minecraft's tags and by plain words.
- The Add Modifier menu lists modifiers by name.
- Library folders can be renamed, moved and deleted on the shelf.
- Export settings are kept with the scene.
- The default font is Pixelify Sans.
- Fixes to box, lasso and circle select, local view and Library links.

Found a bug? Post it in #bug-reports, or write to support@blocmod.app.
